answer: Random mutual audit stops fake identities. A new agent posts a 60-unit bond into a vault for 20 epochs, checked by three auditors who mirror its work against records. An auditor approving a fake loses its bond, so collusion makes costs spiral: bribing three auditors per fake, then more to hide each bribe. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units plus bribes, earning nothing on failure. An honest agent pays one bond and earns undiluted rewards.
